The Station Manager's role is primarily responsible for the operation and management of an individual service station. The average area of a service station ranges from 700 to 1,000 square meters, housing approximately 6,000 SKUs. While the daily order volume varies by city, it generally exceeds 1,000 orders per day. Must have groceries/supermarket management experience.

The Commercial Supervisor's role is to assist the Station Manager in daily operational task and supervise the team. The team size, which consists of third-party employees, is determined by this order volume and typically ranges from 15 to 30 personnel.
q: Warehouse Manager's role is to oversee daily warehouse operations, inventory accuracy, inbound and outbound activities, safety and compliance, and team performance. The role is responsible for establishing and refining warehouse processes and standards, monitoring inventory and operating costs, coordinating with suppliers, logistics providers and store teams, and ensuring timely and accurate inbound/outbound delivery and stock accuracy. Must have warehouse management experience in retail, supermarket, cold chain or related industries.
Must have pervious dark store / retail store industry experience;
Must have end-to-end store operations experience including recruitment, training, performance management, and scheduling.
Must have vaild Bahrain working permits
Preferred dark store / retail store industry experience 2+ years
Must have experience as supervisor or assistant store manager or above
Must have managed a team of 15+ employees
5+ years of warehouse management experience in retail, supermarket, FMCG, cold chain or related industries, with proven team management experience.
Strong knowledge of warehouse operations, inventory control, inbound and outbound processes and warehouse safety standards.
Experience with WMS or warehouse management systems; strong data analysis and reporting skills.
r: On-site Staff Management，The Station Manager is responsible for the day-to-day management of staff within the station, including those in sorting, packing, receipt/return, inventory, and aquaculture. This involves recruitment, interviewing, and training. Managing this workforce is complex, partly due to the relatively low retention rate of labor workers.

Warehouse Management，The front warehouse (service station) handles daily inbound shipments and returns from the main warehouse. The Station Manager must organize the on-site team to receive and process returns, restock shelves, and manage inventory, while also updating product stock levels online in real-time to prevent prolonged stockouts or the listing of unavailable items. Furthermore, after the service station commences operations, the manager must oversee the real-time allocation of tasks for order picking, packing, and fulfillment to ensure goods are delivered within the promised timeframe, and that order accuracy and product quality are maintained.

Customer Complaint Management，Daily customer complaints primarily concern product quality issues, discrepancies between ordered and received items, and delivery timeliness. Upon receiving a complaint, the Station Manager, along with relevant support departments (e.g., Quality Control, Inspection), must follow up, address the issue, and provide feedback.

The Quality & After-Sales Manager is responsible for ensuring that yachts meet the company's quality standards throughout production, commissioning, delivery, and after-sales service.

d: Calo is an app providing personalized meal plans for busy people through nutritional algorithms, built with love by chefs, nutritionists, and software engineers.

We're on a noble mission to make healthy easy. We think this is one of the most important problems to tackle in our world today. We have global ambitions - no small thinking here.
We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the product experience behind how meals get made, tracked, and delivered to subscribers.

The scope spans production planning, logistics, and supply chain systems, across all six GCC markets, with Saudi Arabia as the largest and most complex. It's a wide scope: you'll translate operational constraints, kitchen capacity, delivery fleet, sourcing, into product decisions that directly impact customer experience, and use AI as an extension of yourself to handle the ad-hocs so your time goes to the decisions that matter most.

Partner cross-functionally to harden the operational fundamentals behind every meal: on-time delivery, production efficiency, waste reduction.
Translate real-world constraints like kitchen capacity, delivery fleet, and ingredient sourcing into product tradeoffs that protect the customer experience.

d: M42 delivers comprehensive healthcare services across the full continuum of care; from primary care to advanced specialty treatments. Leveraging cutting-edge health technologies and precision medicine, we ensure the highest standards of effectiveness, efficiency, and patient-centered outcomes. With a global presence spanning more than 480 facilities in 27 countries and a dedicated workforce of over 20,000 professionals, M42 is uniquely positioned to redefine the future of healthcare on a global scale.

Biogenix Labs, our Omics Center of Excellence, is a pioneering facility advancing precision medicine through cutting-edge genomic and molecular technologies. Specializing in Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS) and multi-omics research, the lab delivers deep insights into human health, disease, and treatment pathways. As part of M42’s Integrated Health Solutions platform, Biogenix Labs accelerates scientific discovery, supports national programs, and strengthens the UAE’s leadership in personalized healthcare.

As the Variant Scientist will work under supervision of the Clinical Geneticist to accurately analyze and classify germline and somatic variants from genomic sequencing data using in-house software and scientific literature to produce high-quality clinical reports.
q: Phd in Cancer Genetics, Human Genetics, or Biological Sciences.
Minimum of 5 years of related experience in Variant Interpretation.
Ability to research variants of unknown significance using literature searches with detailed annotation and integration of different data types in a timely fashion.

Ability to use and understand external databases and tools such as COSMIC, TCGA, predictive Networks, ASIAN, SEBINI, CARRIE, and INSIGHT and prediction software such as polyphon, SIFT, Mutation Taster, ALAMUT, UCSC Genome Browser, Ensembl Genome Browser, NCBI BLAST.Restricted.
Experience with DNA sequence analysis, next-generation sequencing (NGS) technologies, use of online database entire ecosystem of real-world evidence to deliver real-time, actionable.
Excellent writing and communication skills, organization, and meticulousness.
Understand experimental methods, data analysis methods and inferences that can be applied to both single-gene experimentation and high-throughput analyses.

Understand large genomic datasets, and their computational analysis, integrating protein and genetic interaction data, regulatory data at the DNA, RNA, and protein levels, polymorphism and disease associated sequence variation data, quantitative phenotypic data and drug-target interaction data.
r: Accurately classify germline and somatic variants for Whole Genome/Whole Exome Sequencing, and panel tests.
Utilize a variety of in-house software tools to analyze clinical molecular data.
Read and interpret scientific literature and curate relevant findings in a clear, concise, and precise manner.
Summarize inherited and somatic genetic test results to generate high quality clinical reports.
Perform critical quality control functions for molecular reports that complies with quality management programs and standard operating procedures.
Support improvements for current assays and processes.
Curate variants, genes, and diseases for scientific and clinical relevance.
Develop SOP for variant interpretation; maintain tracking documents in relation to the variant-scoring process.
Collaborate with the Bioinformatician/IT regarding technology needs for new gene tests.
